args.prompt: Reframe reference 1 into a very wide 3:1 panoramic CLOSE-UP OF THE CASE AND HANDS, preserving its existing generated props and action. Keep EXACTLY THREE separate sealed sample containers in THREE independent protective foam grooves in the same open rugged case: the clear drug tube at LEFT, red blood sample CENTER, pale bone-marrow sample RIGHT. Lids closed, no mixing or spills, no extra vial, no wound or sampling from a body. Keep the player's gloved LEFT foreground hand correctly attached and reaching only for the LEFT container; Kuma's bare hands securely steady the case at the opposite edge. His partial torso, if visible, must match model 2's distressed off-white SHORT-SLEEVE CREW-NECK T-SHIRT, no collared shirt, no buttons/tie. Model 2 is the existing generated Kuma identity/wardrobe; this is deliberately a prop close-up with his HEAD OUTSIDE the shot, not an accidental half face. The full case, all three lid tops, both hand contacts and separate grooves must fit comfortably vertically; make camera/foreshortening suited to the wide panorama instead of cutting off the case lid or bottle bottoms. Same ruined lab street and gritty semi-realistic painterly game style and materials. No text, UI, border, extra people or extra hands.

primaryReferencePolicy: Existing generated models/scenes are primary; original art/photos only check drift.
